people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

people.name: Mary
people.line: Wife of Cleopas (or 'Alphaeus'), present at Jesus' crucifixion.

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

people.name: Salome
people.line: Witness of Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection

translations.web: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
translations.bsb: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
translations.kjv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
translations.asv: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
